$comment: Fixture. Deliberately fails C12 the other way: declares orientation 'inventory' while requiring capabilityStatus, a forward-looking attribute. An inventory profile reports what is. A consumer who selected this profile because it was labelled inventory would receive statements about a future state under that label. Everything else is well-formed.
title: Fixture - C12 inventory profile requiring capability

objective.consumer: A fixture, standing in for a consumer.
objective.decision: Whether the checker holds an inventory profile to present state.
